name: llm-copy
description: Copy page Markdown (RawContent / Foundry .Plain) for LLMs, with optional View-as-markdown modal. Activated by params.llmCopy.enable = true. Data is build-time embedded — no fetch(.md).
entry: partial:llm-copy.html (toolbar + data + modal) | scripts-body-end/extra.html (css+js when enabled)

params.description: Enable page-level Copy for LLM toolbar on content pages.
params.effect: Loads llm-copy.css/js; sub-theme places partial "llm-copy.html" in article header.

params.description: UI variant: "split" (copy + caret menu) or "button" (copy only).
params.effect: Controls whether the caret dropdown is rendered.

params.description: Show View as markdown in the menu (split variant).
params.effect: Adds menu item that opens the markdown modal.

params.description: Show Open in ChatGPT / Claude menu items.
params.effect: When true, menu opens external AI apps with a prompt containing page URL.

css.note: Override --mdf-llm-* CSS variables in sub-theme CSS to match brand

js.note: Reads #mdf-page-markdown JSON; binds #mdf-llm-copy actions. No external deps.

locked.reason: llm-copy.js binds by these IDs/attrs. Renaming breaks the capability.

partials.note: Safe to restyle markup classes; keep locked IDs and data-mdf-llm-action attrs
Base auto-injects css+js when params.llmCopy.enable; keep that branch if overriding

activation_pattern.template:
[params.llmCopy]
enable = true
variant = "split"
viewMarkdown = true
external = false

# In article header:
{{ partial "llm-copy.html" . }}
